intuition: A robot must respond to the object in its hand, not only to the object it practiced with in simulation.
learningGoal: Connect physical-world simulation, vision-language-action policies, and sim-to-real evaluation in NVIDIA physical AI research.
exerciseNote: The inline reality-gap experiment uses Python’s standard library on a CPU. Full Cosmos or GR00T work has separate model, GPU, licensing, and hardware requirements.

quiz.question: Scenario: A humanoid robot learned to pick up warehouse boxes in simulation. In a real-world test, it grasps an unfamiliar slippery box, and the grasp begins to fail. What should it do?
quiz.explanation: Real feedback can reveal a sim-to-real mismatch. Correction or a safe stop within physical limits is preferable to blindly continuing the simulated plan.
choices: Continue the original movement regardless of feedback.
Increase gripping force without checking fragility or hardware limits.
Detect instability, respect safety limits, and adjust or stop using feedback.
Assume simulation success guarantees physical success.
